Great fit for wellness apps, family podcasts, AI assistants, and educational content across platforms like Calm, Headspace, YouTube Kids, and Alexa/Google Assistant experiences.

Ideal for audiobooks, narration, documentaries, cinematic storytelling, trailers, meditation, sleep stories, commercials, true crime, history, mythology, poetry, fantasy, sci-fi, gothic fiction & horror.

A distinctive sound designed to capture attention, build trust, and make every message memorable.

Ideal for documentary, history and nature narration, audiobooks, trailers, and rugged character work.

The delivery feels like an experienced mentor speaking one-on-one. Direct. Engaging, trustworthy, and comfortable shifting between lighthearted conversation, thoughtful reflection, and serious professional topics.

Great at delivering bad news in a calm way! Inspired by classic science-fiction computer voices.
